name: Build
description: Updates to the build system, scripts, or dependencies.

name: Chore
description: Updates to tools, configurations, or libraries; no production code changes.

name: Feature
description: A new function or capability for the user.

name: Performance
description: Improvements to execution speed or load times.

name: Refactor
description: Restructuring logic to improve code quality without changing behavior.

name: Style
description: Formatting changes that do not affect meaning (e.g., whitespace).
